faqs.q: What are laser-welded fin tubes used for?
faqs.a: Laser-welded fin tubes have fins laser-welded to the base tube with a narrow, low-heat weld, which suits thin stainless and alloy fins on thin-wall tube. They are used in heat recovery and in compact coils that see moisture or corrosive air.

faqs.q: What fin and wall thickness do laser-welded fin tubes have?
faqs.a: Fin thickness is 0.3–1.0 mm on a base tube wall of 0.8–1.5 mm. Sizes are made to order and confirmed with the quotation, so send OD, wall, length and quantity.

faqs.q: What are the advantages of laser-welded fins over wound fins?
faqs.a: The laser fuses the fin root to the tube in a narrow, continuous weld with a small heat-affected zone, so thin fins join thin-wall tube without burning through or distorting it. There is no contact gap to open up with thermal cycling and no crevice for corrosion.

faqs.q: Which materials can be laser-welded for fin tubes?
faqs.a: Stainless steel and carbon steel fins on stainless or carbon steel tube. Confirm the grade combination on the enquiry, along with the gas or air the fins will see and any coating or galvanising.

faqs.q: What certificate comes with laser-welded fin tubes?
faqs.a: A mill test certificate to EN 10204 3.1 is available on request, and third-party inspection can be arranged against your inspection and test plan. Base tubes come with their mill certificates.

faqs.q: What is checked on a finished laser-welded fin tube?
faqs.a: The fin bond and fin pitch are checked along the length, and the finished tubes are packed in crates with the bare ends protected. State your inspection and test plan with the enquiry.

faqs.q: Laser-welded fin tubes or embedded G-fin tubes: which fin form?
faqs.a: Choose laser-welded fins when thin stainless or alloy fins must be joined to thin-wall tube with a narrow, continuous weld. Compare the other fin forms on the [embedded G-fin tubes](/c/embedded-g-fin-tubes) and the [types of finned tubes guide](/blog/types-of-finned-tubes).

faqs.q: Can laser-welded fin tubes replace existing finned tubes?
faqs.a: Yes. Send the old drawing or a sample length and we measure the base tube and the fin before quoting, so the new tubes fit the existing bundle and tube supports.

faqs.q: Where are laser-welded fin tubes used?
faqs.a: They are used in heat recovery, compact coils and stainless finned tube for moist or corrosive air. Fouling and cleaning choices are in our [finned tube fouling and cleaning guide](/blog/finned-tube-fouling-cleaning).

faqs.q: What should I send to quote laser-welded fin tubes?
faqs.a: Send base tube standard, grade, OD and wall, fin type, material, height, thickness and fins per inch, finned length and bare length at each end, overall length, quantity, design temperature, the gas or air, any coating and inspection requirements.

faqs.q: Is the Laser-Welded Fin Tubes available from Indus Hydraulics in Dubai, and what is the lead time?
faqs.a: The Laser-Welded Fin Tubes is built to order and supplied from Dubai, UAE, with shipping worldwide. The lead time is confirmed on the quotation. Send the size, rating and quantity through [our contact page](/contact) and we confirm the build and delivery date.

faqs.q: Can laser-welded fin tubes be supplied in random or cut lengths?
faqs.a: Yes: random or fixed lengths, cut to length on request. The finned length and the bare length at each end are stated on the order.
